newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up 25 cents on year-end covering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up 25 cents on year-end covering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended the last trading session of the year 25 cents higher at 14.85 ringgit ($5.88) a kg due to covering mainly by European buyers, traders said.

"This is quite normal on the last trading day of the year. Those who are short are covering their positions," said one trader. "Buying was mainly from Europe and there was also a bit of local interest."
Traders said a higher tin price on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight also helped sentiment.
Traders noted initial bids for 304 tonnes against offers for 145 tonnes. Final turnover was 201 tonnes, up from 72 tonnes on Monday.
The local price premium over the LME widened to $270 a tonne against $200 previously, the traders said.
The market is closed on Wednesday for the New Year holiday.
